items.headline: Wright accounts for 4TDs to send Buffalo past Miami (Ohio) 34-31 in OT
items.description: — Jason Wright threw for 358 yards and accounted for four touchdowns and Buffalo rallied in the fourth quarter to beat Miami of Ohio 34-31 in overtime on Tuesday night.
